title: augmanitai-wow: AUGMANITAI Knowledge Graph — Interactive Force-Directed Graph of 79 Human-AI Interaction Terms
description: Interactive force-directed knowledge graph of 79 curated AUGMANITAI terms with 232 semantic and explicit edges, category-cluster convex hulls, minimap, and PNG export. Single-file HTML artifact with hand-written vanilla JavaScript and no external dependencies. Curated public excerpt from the larger AUGMANITAI compendium.
